user_stories.title: Create GitHub Actions workflow directory and CI configuration file
acceptance_criteria: File .github/workflows/ci.yml exists in the repository
Workflow file is valid YAML with no syntax errors
Workflow name is 'CI' as specified in the configuration
Workflow triggers on push to master branch
Workflow triggers on pull_request to master branch
Workflow uses ubuntu-latest as the runner
Workflow uses actions/setup-go@v5 with Go version 1.23
Workflow uses actions/setup-python@v5 with Python version 3.11
user_stories.notes: This is the foundational user story - without the workflow file, no automation can occur. The workflow structure follows GitHub Actions best practices with sequential steps in a single job.

user_stories.title: Configure Go toolchain and install Go dependencies
acceptance_criteria: Go 1.23 is installed and available in the PATH
golangci-lint is installed via 'go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest'
goimports is installed via 'go install golang.org/x/tools/cmd/goimports@latest'
Both tools are accessible and can be executed by subsequent steps
Go installation matches the version specified in go.mod:3 (1.23.0 requirement)
user_stories.notes: Go tools must be installed before running make ci, as the Makefile depends on golangci-lint and goimports. These tools are not pre-installed on GitHub Actions runners.

user_stories.title: Configure Python environment and install Python dependencies
acceptance_criteria: Python 3.11 is installed and available in the PATH
uv package manager is installed via pip
uv sync is run from the tools/ directory successfully
Python dependencies from tools/auto_prd/pyproject.toml are installed
Virtual environment is created and activated for tool usage
user_stories.notes: Python tests and linting require the virtual environment with dependencies. The uv sync command creates the .venv directory and installs all project dependencies including ruff, mypy, and pytest.

user_stories.title: Execute complete CI pipeline via make ci command
acceptance_criteria: make ci command runs successfully from repository root
All linting checks pass (make lint-go and make lint-py)
All Go tests pass (make test-go)
Race detector tests pass (make test-go-race)
Type checking runs in lenient mode (make typecheck-lenient)
Workflow shows final success status with all green checkmarks
Total CI execution completes in under 10 minutes
user_stories.notes: The make ci target orchestrates all checks. This is the final step that validates the entire codebase. The typecheck-lenient target uses '|| true' to avoid blocking during rollout, as documented in Makefile:87.

user_stories.title: Verify CI workflow triggers and executes on actual GitHub repository
acceptance_criteria: Push to wreckit/007-create-github-cicd-workflow branch triggers the workflow
Workflow appears in GitHub Actions tab with all steps visible
All workflow steps complete successfully
Pull request created to master branch shows CI checks in PR validation
CI checks show as passed in the pull request interface
Workflow logs are accessible and show make ci output
user_stories.notes: This is the integration testing story - validating that the workflow not only exists but actually works in the real GitHub environment. This requires pushing the actual workflow file to GitHub and observing the results.
